_comment: Example config for the deploy, pull and push scripts. The full guide: scripts/README.md.
Setup: copy this file, remove .example from the name (deploy.config.json) and replace the placeholders below with the real details. deploy.config.json is ignored by git.
Production: the same, in deploy.prod.json (also ignored by git); the commands ending in :prod use it.
Then run `npm run ftp-cert` (or `npm run ftp-cert:prod`) to pin the FTPS certificate into ca, and preview with `npm run deploy -- --dry-run`.
Keep FTP details only in deploy.*.json files: deploy never uploads them, except this example.
